select A.DM_ID ,A.DM_NM ,A.DM_SYS_CD ,(select SYS_NM from TB_SYS_INFO where sys_cd = A.DM_SYS_CD) as DM_SYS_NM ,A.DM_DS_ID ,(select DSN from ndata.TB_DATA_SOURCE where ds_id = A.DM_DS_ID) as DM_DS_NM ,COALESCE(A.MODEL_TYPE, 'PHYSICAL') as MODEL_TYPE ,A.VER ,COALESCE(A.STRUCT_DIAG_YN, 'N') as STRUCT_DIAG_YN ,to_char(A.STRUCT_DIAG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as STRUCT_DIAG_DT_FMT ,COALESCE(SD.STRUCT_DIAG_RATE, -1) as STRUCT_DIAG_RATE ,COALESCE(D.DIAG_STND_RATE, 0) as DIAG_STND_RATE ,D.DIAG_DT_FMT ,(select count(*) from TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ where DM_ID = A.DM_ID and USE_YN='Y') as OBJ_CNT ,(select count(*) from TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR where DM_ID = A.DM_ID and USE_YN='Y') as ATTR_CNT ,(select to_char(to_timestamp(max(CLCT_END_DT),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') from TB_DATA_MODEL_CLCT where DM_ID = A.DM_ID and CLCT_CMPTN_YN='Y') as CLCT_DT from TB_DATA_MODEL A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( select J.DM_ID, CASE WHEN J.TOTAL_CNT > 0 THEN ROUND(((J.TOTAL_CNT - COALESCE(IC.ISSUE_COL_CNT, 0))::decimal / J.TOTAL_CNT) * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END as DIAG_STND_RATE, to_char(to_timestamp(J.END_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as DIAG_DT_FMT from TB_DIAG_JOB J LEFT JOIN ( select DIAG_JOB_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT OBJ_NM || '.' || ATTR_NM) as ISSUE_COL_CNT from TB_DIAG_RESULT group by DIAG_JOB_ID ) IC on IC.DIAG_JOB_ID = J.DIAG_JOB_ID where J.STATUS = 'DONE' and J.END_DT = (select max(END_DT) from TB_DIAG_JOB where DM_ID = J.DM_ID and STATUS = 'DONE') ) D on A.DM_ID = D.DM_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ( select h.DATA_MODEL_ID, CASE WHEN (h.TOTAL_TABLES + h.TOTAL_COLUMNS) > 0 THEN ROUND((1.0 - (h.ADDED_TABLES + h.DELETED_TABLES + h.ADDED_COLUMNS + h.DELETED_COLUMNS + h.MODIFIED_COLUMNS)::decimal / (h.TOTAL_TABLES + h.TOTAL_COLUMNS)) * 100, 1) ELSE 100 END as STRUCT_DIAG_RATE from TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY h where h.STATUS = 'DONE' and h.DIAG_DT = (select max(DIAG_DT) from TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY where DATA_MODEL_ID = h.DATA_MODEL_ID and STATUS = 'DONE') ) SD on A.DM_ID = SD.DATA_MODEL_ID where A.USE_YN = 'Y'

DELETE FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ WHERE DM_ID = #{dataModelId} AND COALESCE(OBJ_OWNER, '') = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{objOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), '') AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR WHERE DM_ID = #{dataModelId} AND COALESCE(OBJ_OWNER, '') = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{objOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), '') AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm} AND ATTR_NM = #{attrNm}

SELECT OBJ_OWNER as "objOwner" ,TABLE_NM as "objNm" ,CONSTRAINT_NM as "constraintNm" ,CONSTRAINT_TYPE as "constraintType" ,COLUMN_NM as "columnNm" ,COLUMN_POS as "columnPos" ,REF_OWNER as "refOwner" ,REF_TABLE_NM as "refTableNm" ,REF_COLUMN_NM as "refColumnNm" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_CONSTRAINT WHERE DM_ID = #{dataModelId} AND COALESCE(USE_YN,'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY TABLE_NM, CONSTRAINT_NM, COLUMN_POS

SELECT CONSTRAINT_NM as "constraintNm" ,CONSTRAINT_TYPE as "constraintType" ,COLUMN_NM as "columnNm" ,COLUMN_POS as "columnPos" ,REF_OWNER as "refOwner" ,REF_TABLE_NM as "refTableNm" ,REF_COLUMN_NM as "refColumnNm" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_CONSTRAINT WHERE DM_ID = #{dataModelId} AND COALESCE(OBJ_OWNER, '') = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{objOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), '') AND TABLE_NM = #{objNm} AND COALESCE(USE_YN,'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY CONSTRAINT_NM, COLUMN_POS
mapper.update: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT DM_ID, OBJ_OWNER, OBJ_NM, ATTR_NM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY DM_ID, OBJ_OWNER, OBJ_NM ORDER BY ATTR_ORD NULLS LAST, ATTR_NM ) AS rn FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR WHERE DM_ID = #{dataModelId} AND COALESCE(OBJ_OWNER, '') = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{objOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), '') AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ) UPDATE TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR a SET ATTR_ORD = ranked.rn FROM ranked WHERE a.DM_ID = ranked.DM_ID AND a.OBJ_OWNER = ranked.OBJ_OWNER AND a.OBJ_NM = ranked.OBJ_NM AND a.ATTR_NM = ranked.ATTR_NM AND a.ATTR_ORD IS DISTINCT FROM ranked.rn
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR WHERE DM_ID = #{dataModelId} AND COALESCE(OBJ_OWNER, '') = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{objOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), '') AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm} AND ATTR_NM = #{attrNm}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT CONSTRAINT_NM as constraintNm, OBJ_OWNER as objOwner, TABLE_NM as tableNm FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_CONSTRAINT WHERE DM_ID = #{dataModelId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'R' AND COALESCE(REF_OWNER, '') = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{refOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), '') AND REF_TABLE_NM = #{refTableNm} AND REF_COLUMN_NM IN #{col}

SELECT CONSTRAINT_NM as constraintNm, CONSTRAINT_TYPE as constraintType FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_CONSTRAINT WHERE DM_ID = #{dataModelId} AND COALESCE(OBJ_OWNER, '') = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{objOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), '') AND TABLE_NM = #{objNm} AND COLUMN_NM = #{attrNm} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT INDEX_NM as indexNm FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_INDEX WHERE DM_ID = #{dataModelId} AND COALESCE(OBJ_OWNER, '') = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{objOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), '') AND TABLE_NM = #{objNm} AND COLUMN_NM = #{attrNm} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT CONSTRAINT_NM as constraintNm, OBJ_OWNER as objOwner, TABLE_NM as tableNm, COLUMN_NM as columnNm FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_CONSTRAINT WHERE DM_ID = #{dataModelId} AND COALESCE(REF_OWNER, '') = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{objOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), '') AND REF_TABLE_NM = #{objNm} AND REF_COLUMN_NM = #{attrNm} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT
'SELECT USERNAME AS schemaNm FROM ALL_USERS WHERE USERNAME IN (SELECT DISTINCT OWNER FROM ALL_TABLES) ORDER BY USERNAME'
'SELECT SCHEMA_NAME AS schemaNm FROM information_schema.SCHEMATA WHERE SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN (''information_schema'',''mysql'',''performance_schema'',''sys'') ORDER BY SCHEMA_NAME'
'SELECT DISTINCT OWNER_NAME AS schemaNm FROM DB_CLASS WHERE is_system_class = ''NO'' AND CLASS_TYPE = ''CLASS'' ORDER BY OWNER_NAME'
'SELECT name AS schemaNm FROM sys.schemas ORDER BY name'
'SELECT schema_name AS schemaNm FROM information_schema.schemata ORDER BY schema_name'
AS sql
